A1.justification: Both complete 22-page PDFs describe the same PVChat work, with readable text, equations, tables and figures. The eleven supplementary pages, covering S1–S7, are identical in extracted text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v1 reports original model comparisons in Table 1, component and data ablations in Tables 2–4, and token-count experiments in supplementary Table 1.

after.justification: v2 retains these original quantitative experiments and qualitative demonstrations, including the supplementary token-count results and multi-person examples.

M1.justification: The augmentation pipeline, ReMoH routing, SPR and HAE objectives, two-stage training, and supplementary multi-character masking procedure are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same six scenarios, 25 characters, and existence, appearance, action and location questions. Coverage of single-person and multi-person cases is retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains InternVideo2 and VideoLLaMA2. Table 2 retains the Q-former/LLM baseline and its MoH variant alongside ReMoH; no comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and supplementary S2/S4 retain the same reference/query selection, five metrics, eight-frame sampling, training budgets and multi-character settings. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The ReMoH, SPR/HAE and augmentation-source ablations, head-activation analysis, supplementary token-count sensitivity study and qualitative cases are unchanged. Figure 7 is relocated without changing its analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point-estimate reporting. Neither reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: All entries in main Tables 1–4 and supplementary Table 1 match. For example, Table 1 retains PVChat's Acc 0.901, BLEU 0.562, BS 0.952, ES 4.940 and DC 4.201. The plotted activation patterns and qualitative outputs also match.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(11), including attention routing, sparsity regularization and the combined objective, are unchanged. There are no added or revised formal assumptions, derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same claims about the first one-shot personalized ViLLM, automated dataset construction, ReMoH and superior personalized video understanding.

C2.justification: Both retain the same interpretations of head specialization, SPR/HAE effects, identity-consistency tradeoffs and excessive-token degradation. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added.

D1.justification: The backbone, GPU, learning rates, batch size, training time, multi-character implementation and prompt templates remain unchanged. The future dataset-release statement is retained without new code or data access instructions.

R1.justification: Both versions cite the same 61 references and retain the same research positioning. Bibliographic differences only update citation-page backreferences following reflow.

P1.justification: The author block adds MedVisAI Lab and Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine affiliations, revises affiliation markers and punctuation, and changes the email domain from e.ntu.edu to e.ntu.edu.sg. Research prose and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Author/abstract spacing and surrounding text and table positions change. Figure 4 moves from PDF page 5 to 6, and Figure 7 from page 8 to 9. Figure contents, table structures, captions and supplementary layout are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 updates author information and reflows existing material while retaining the methods, explanations, numerical evidence and complete supplement. These limited administrative and layout changes establish no meaningful net difference in the paper's clarity, reproducibility or scientific support.
